insight: Hit $20M ARR within ~2 months of its Oct 2024 launch, often cited as the fastest-growing software product after ChatGPT.
name: Bolt.new
tagline: Prompt-to-app generator running in the browser. WebContainers under the hood.
description: StackBlitz's in-browser full-stack app builder. Generates a working project — frontend, backend, deps — and lets you iterate in a sandboxed Node runtime without leaving the tab.
edge: Runs the whole Node stack in-browser via WebContainers, giving a real full-stack IDE no rival sandbox matches.
pros: Full Node stack runs in the browser tab
Code-first with a real editable IDE
Good for modern JS framework projects
cons: Token usage can burn fast on iteration
